subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To get cold feet
solution:
The correct answer is: **To be afraid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To get cold feet"** means to suddenly become too frightened to do something one had planned to do. (डर जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** She was excited about the trip, but she got cold feet at the last moment and decided not to go.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To fall sick** (बीमार पड़ना): To become ill.

 
 
• **Example:** He had to cancel the meeting because he fell sick suddenly.
 
 
 
• **To be indifferent** (उदासीन होना): To show no interest or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** She was indifferent to the praise she received for her work.
 
 
 
• **To run for life** (जान बचाने के लिए भागना): To flee in order to save oneself from danger.
 
 
• **Example:** When the fire broke out, everyone ran for their lives.
